name: ahar-visualizer
description: Visualizes agent-harnesses-standard structure in a workspace.

aharVisualizer.maxDepth.description: A directory at exactly this depth from the harness root (root itself is depth 0) becomes the collapse boundary when the tree first loads or refreshes — it stays visible, but nothing deeper than it does, until expanded.

aharVisualizer.maxNodesBeforeCollapse.description: If the fully-expanded tree would show more nodes than this, deeper directories are automatically collapsed (deepest first) until the visible count is back under this limit.

aharVisualizer.maxChildrenBeforeCollapse.description: Any directory with more direct file/child nodes than this starts collapsed, regardless of its depth.

aharVisualizer.maxNodesOnExpand.description: Expanding a collapsed directory only reveals as much of its subtree as fits under this many nodes; anything beyond that stays collapsed so one click can't dump a huge subtree onto the canvas at once.

aharVisualizer.rescanIntervalMs.description: How often (in milliseconds) to re-scan for the most recently active Claude Code session and switch to it if it's changed. Lower is more responsive; higher is cheaper on a repo with a lot of session history.
